process: SO2 cover gas in place of SF6 (Sect. 4)
measure: Alternative SO2 cover gas system at primary smelters
saving: 100 (SF6 emissions at converting facilities); 86 of 1990 non-energy GHG by 2010
note: Paper gives no capital cost. It states SO2 is less efficient than SF6 so metal losses may offset cover-gas savings, and that the industry pursues cheaper alternatives. See nccp_1999_003 Table 4-6 (under 3 million CAD per smelter) and nccp_1999_004 Sect. 5.6 for costs.
